name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) Standard Terms, allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other for a stated purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Fill-in cover page for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, used to complete party details and key terms before signing.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) Standard Terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement, used to give a prospective customer early access to a product in exchange for feedback before a general release.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) Standard Terms, designed to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement to define uptime and response time commitments.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform services described in a statement of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Standard Terms, governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement Standard Terms for licensing software to be installed and used on a customer's own systems.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement Standard Terms for business partnerships, including trademark licensing and shared obligations between companies.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Standard Terms, addressing HIPAA obligations between a covered entity and a business associate handling protected health information.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement Standard Terms, a short-term contract letting a prospective customer trial a product or service before committing to a longer-term deal.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum Standard Terms, supplementing an underlying agreement with terms governing the use of AI services, inputs, outputs, and model training.
